# LilyPond import fixtures

These public-domain Mutopia editions are unmodified. Each accompanying `.notes` file gives the visible written notes from the corresponding LilyPond source. Each line is one measure. Entries encode staff, sounding MIDI pitch, onset within the measure and duration in quarter notes. Repeated entries preserve unisons belonging to different voices. The source transcription was cross-checked against Mutopia’s published MIDI after joining ties and simultaneous unisons.

| Score | Engraver | PDF and source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| BWV 999, single-staff lute/guitar arrangement | Jakob Bagterp | [Letter PDF](https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/BachJS/BWV999/Bach_Prelude_BWV999/Bach_Prelude_BWV999-let.pdf) · [LilyPond](https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/BachJS/BWV999/Bach_Prelude_BWV999/Bach_Prelude_BWV999.ly) |
| BWV 928, keyboard | Andreas Scherer | [A4 PDF](https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/BachJS/BWV928/prelude_9/prelude_9-a4.pdf) · [LilyPond](https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/BachJS/BWV928/prelude_9/prelude_9.ly) |
| BWV 870, keyboard | Urs Metzger | [Letter PDF](https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/BachJS/BWV870/wtk2prelude1/wtk2prelude1-let.pdf) · [LilyPond](https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/BachJS/BWV870/wtk2prelude1/wtk2prelude1.ly) |

The Chopin op. 64 no. 1 regression uses the unmodified public-domain Mutopia PDF and MIDI from the same edition. The MIDI supplies an independent reference for both hands in the closing passage, including the octave shift that starts on the preceding eighth note. [Edition and downloads](https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=483)

Handel’s Entrée from the Aylesford Pieces uses Bas Wassink’s public-domain Mutopia edition based on Edition Schott 1930. The accompanying `handel-entree.notes` transcribes the LilyPond source and adds a `staccato` field to marked notes or the lowest note of a marked chord. Its pitches, onsets and durations agree with the published MIDI after joining the tie and collapsing the three same-staff unisons. The PDF and MIDI are unmodified. [Edition and downloads](https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=150)
